newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on exporters' activity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on exporters' activity.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished slightly higher against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday as exporters took profits on the U.S. dollar after the greenback's recent rise against the local currency, dealers said.
The local unit, which ended at an 11-month low on Friday, finished at T$27.802 against Friday's T$27.824 close. Turnover through dealers was US$83 million in the abbreviated Saturday session.
"The market was quiet on Saturday. And exporters' selling of the greenback easily pushed up the local currency," said one dealer.
But a downward trend was seen for the local unit in the near term due to persistent capital outflows, dealers said.
For next week, a T$27.80-27.85 range was seen.
